title: Model-internal rho+omega VMD estimate of the hadronic Delta alpha(M_Z) piece, and its effect on B6/B9's EW leg

V1.what: s>>m_V^2 asymptotic closed form matches the exact narrow-resonance dispersion integral

V2.what: g_omega,EM/g_rho,EM = 3 exactly, from quark charges Q_u=2/3, Q_d=-1/3 alone (not F128/F240's baryon coherence, independently the same number)

V3.what: rho+omega VMD piece is positive and strictly below the full data-driven hadronic Delta alpha (a physical necessity: two resonances cannot exceed the whole spectrum)

V4.what: captured fraction of DHMZ2020 Delta alpha_had^(5)(M_Z) lands in the physically sane range for two light narrow resonances out of the full hadronic spectrum (not <3%: too small to be the leading resonances; not >30%: rho+omega alone do not dominate a spectrum that also has phi, 4pi, and the continuum)

V5.what: universality (g_rho,EM = g_rhopipi) needs a downward quench on the coupling to match the PDG rho0->e+e- width -- the SAME direction (quench, not enhancement) F240 already found for g_rhoNN and g_sigmaNN (0.43, 0.45), here measured independently via a third, electromagnetic channel rather than assumed

V6.what: adding the VMD piece moves 1/alpha_MSbar(M_Z) and sin^2 theta_W(M_Z) toward PDG (not past it, not away from it) and closes a genuine, bounded fraction of the gap L4 attributed to the missing hadronic piece

control-charge-weight.what: charge_weight_control=1.0 (drops the exact x3 isoscalar/isovector ratio) reddens V2 and ONLY V2

control-dhmz-reference.what: dhmz_reference_control=0.001 (a wildly wrong external anchor) reddens V4 and ONLY V4

photon_charge_weights.statement: g_V,EM in Gamma(V->e+e-) = 4 pi alpha^2 m_V/(3 g_V^2) sits in the denominator of the mixing term, so g_omega,EM/g_rho,EM = (isovector weight)/(isoscalar weight) = 3 exactly, from Q_u=2/3, Q_d=-1/3 alone.

g_V,EM in Gamma(V->e+e-) = 4 pi alpha^2 m_V/(3 g_V^2) sits in the denominator of the mixing term, so g_omega,EM/g_rho,EM = (isovector weight)/(isoscalar weight) = 3 exactly, from Q_u=2/3, Q_d=-1/3 alone.

hadronic_vmd.statement: rho+omega narrow-resonance VMD, zero imported couplings (g_rhopipi is the model's own F103/F240 KSRF output): Delta alpha_V(M_Z) captures a double-digit-percent fraction of DHMZ2020's Delta alpha_had^(5)(M_Z); the universality posit itself needs the same O(15-30%) quench direction F240 already found in two other channels (NN vector, NN scalar), measured here against the PDG rho0->e+e- width rather than assumed.

hadronic_vmd.statement: rho+omega narrow-resonance VMD, zero imported couplings (g_rhopipi is the model's own F103/F240 KSRF output): Delta alpha_V(M_Z) captures a double-digit-percent fraction of DHMZ2020's Delta alpha_had^(5)(M_Z); the universality posit itself needs the same O(15-30%) quench direction F240 already found in two other channels (NN vector, NN scalar), measured here against the PDG rho0->e+e- width rather than assumed.

ew_leg_with_hadronic_vmd.statement: Adding the model-internal rho+omega VMD hadronic piece moves 1/alpha_MSbar(M_Z) and sin^2 theta_W(M_Z) in the correct direction, closing roughly a tenth of the gap to PDG that L4 attributed entirely to the missing hadronic vacuum polarisation. The remainder needs either the data-driven value (as before) or the resonances/continuum this two-resonance estimate does not include.
